# Slowroll / 슬로우롤

> A disposable film camera on the web. Shoot a 24-frame roll, never see a shot,
> and the whole roll develops at once after a real 3-day (72-hour) wait.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://slowroll.try-dabble.com/
Frames are stored only on this device; the roll state and the absolute unlock time
stay in this browser. No accounts, no uploads, no server storage of any image.

This is NOT a photo editor, a gallery, or a filter app. There is NO preview of a
captured shot, NO per-frame delete or retake, and NO way to see a frame before the
countdown reaches zero (other than one explicit, confirmed "develop early" control).

## Pages

- [Home](https://slowroll.try-dabble.com/): Camera body, film counter, shutter, darkroom countdown, developed rolls
- [Privacy](https://slowroll.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://slowroll.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/slowroll): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Live viewfinder from the device camera (rear camera preferred) before the shutter
- 24-frame roll with a mechanical film-counter dial showing frames left at all times
- Two develop modes chosen when a roll is loaded: when the roll is full (default), or 3 days after the first shot
- Finish roll now: seals the roll early and starts the same real 72-hour wait
- Absolute unlock timestamp: reloading or closing the tab never resets or shortens the wait
- Live darkroom countdown in days, hours, minutes and seconds
- The whole roll appears at once when the timer ends, printed with a warm tone and light grain
- Download each print or all of them to the device
- Discard is only ever the whole roll, behind a confirm dialog
- Fallback: add photos from this device when no camera is available (still no preview)
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
